vars.name: TARGET_URL
vars.description: Beads-viewer base URL to audit. DEFAULT is the in-cluster ClusterIP DNS http://gardenio-beads-viewer.gardenio-system.svc.cluster.local:8095, which agent pods reach DIRECTLY with no port-forward and no bearer — the flat-org user page renders full content anonymously. (The Keycloak client_credentials bearer + port-forward are unavailable to the agent SA on prod per bug ka-0000007323, so the legacy localhost:8095 tunnel path is best-effort only. In CI/staging where the bearer + port-forward work, set TARGET_URL=http://localhost:8095 and the same steps authenticate.) The harness hits {{TARGET_URL}}/u/{{USER_SLUG}} plus its htmx sub-sections, and a cross-view (a non-owner fetch of a busy operator's page) to prove total transparency.

vars.name: USER_SLUG
vars.description: Canonical homepage slug of a REAL prod operator to audit (e.g. sam.rivers). Ships EMPTY by default so step 1 always discovers a currently-busy human from the live /people directory. The audit captures /u/{{USER_SLUG}} as page 'user-home'.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (date stamp or fire-time ISO) used as the output directory name under docs/users-flat/<ITERATION>/. Keeps multiple pours from colliding.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work. All bug beads filed by the file-issues step are parented here so the operator can browse one tree per dimension.

steps.title: Users-FLAT ({{ITERATION}}): reach {{TARGET_URL}} (anon direct DNS; best-effort bearer) and pick a self-view + a cross-view operator
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup + Pick TWO audit users (self-view + cross-view)

This gardener encodes the operator's goal verbatim: **total user activity transparency, with no junk, all in time-series order.** Two facts make this audit different from the older CDQR pass:

1. **gardenio is a FLAT org.** A user's page is a PUBLIC activity record. Cross-user body redaction was removed (ka-0000003111): there is NO 'message bodies are hidden' banner, and beads-viewer applies **no per-viewer redaction of activity content** (verified structurally — `isViewerSelf` gates only owner affordances like the `(you)` label, edit buttons, and the last-visit divider, never body text). So an **anonymous or non-owner** fetch of `/u/<slug>` shows *exactly* the same bodies the owner sees — that anonymous cross-view IS the transparency proof.
2. **The page should read as one chronological stream**, not a scatter of disconnected section cards. The rubric's headline dimension is **time-series order**.

### Reach the viewer — DIRECT ClusterIP DNS (no bearer required)

`{{TARGET_URL}}` defaults to the in-cluster ClusterIP DNS
`http://gardenio-beads-viewer.gardenio-system.svc.cluster.local:8095`, which agent
pods reach **directly** — no port-forward, no bearer. The flat-org user page
renders full content anonymously, so an unauthenticated GET is sufficient for
this audit.

> **Why not the Keycloak bearer + port-forward?** On new-prod the agent
> ServiceAccount **cannot** mint a `client_credentials` bearer nor create a
> port-forward (bug ka-0000007323: no RBAC to read the audit-client Secret, no
> `pods/portforward`). The old "mint or `exit 1`" gate is exactly what stalled
> the 2026-07-06 iteration. Both are now **best-effort**: try them, and if they
> work (e.g. in CI/staging, or once ka-0000007323 lands) use the authenticated
> self-view; if they fail, **DO NOT BLOCK** — fall back to the anonymous direct
> path, which is a valid FLAT audit.

```bash
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio-system)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}
BASE='{{TARGET_URL}}'

# Best-effort bearer (authenticated self-view). Never fatal.
VIEWER_BEARER=""
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
if source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh 2>/dev/null; then
  VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token 2>/dev/null) || VIEWER_BEARER=""
fi
AUTH=(); [ -n "$VIEWER_BEARER" ] && AUTH=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER")
if [ -n "$VIEWER_BEARER" ]; then echo "auth: bearer minted (authenticated self-view available)"; else echo "auth: ANONYMOUS (bearer unavailable — expected on prod per ka-0000007323; flat-org anon view is full)"; fi

# Best-effort operator-row bootstrap (only matters for an authenticated self-view;
# harmless no-op anonymously). Only attempted if a bearer was minted; failures are
# swallowed (the agent SA cannot port-forward on prod — ka-0000007323).
if [ -n "$VIEWER_BEARER" ]; then
  kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads 8080:8080 >/tmp/beads-daemon-pf.log 2>&1 &
  BEADS_PF_PID=$!; trap 'kill $BEADS_PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
  sleep 2
  curl -fsS -X POST "${AUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-users-flat-audit","source":"audit-bootstrap"}' \
    http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

# Warm the viewer (works with or without AUTH).
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null "${AUTH[@]}" "$BASE/health" && break; sleep 1; done
```

### Pick the audit users (USER_SLUG empty by default -> discover from /people)

Discover real slugs from the live `/people` directory (NOT `/agents`, whose rows render no per-user links; NOT by guessing — real slugs are dotted full names like `sam.rivers`). `/people` hrefs carry a `/beads` reverse-proxy prefix; STRIP it before hitting `{{TARGET_URL}}` (`/u/<slug>` is 200; `/beads/u/<slug>` 404s against the direct DNS).

```bash
mapfile -t SLUGS < <(curl -s "${AUTH[@]}" "$BASE/people" \
  | grep -oE 'href="/beads/u/[^"]+"' | sed -E 's|href="/beads/u/||;s|"||' \
  | grep -vE '^(op-|group_|e2e-fixture|info-density-audit|gardenio2|gardenio$)' | sort -u)
printf '%s\n' "${SLUGS[@]}" | head -40
# Rank by live homepage activity; pick the BUSIEST as the self-view (SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG),
# and a DIFFERENT busy operator as the cross-view (XVIEW_SLUG).
best=""; best_n=-1; second=""; second_n=-1
for s in "${SLUGS[@]}"; do
  html=$(curl -s "${AUTH[@]}" "$BASE/u/$s")
  [ -z "$html" ] && continue
  n=$(printf '%s' "$html" | grep -oE 'user-inbox-msg|bead-row|\([0-9]+\)' | wc -l)
  if [ "$n" -gt "$best_n" ]; then second=$best; second_n=$best_n; best=$s; best_n=$n;
  elif [ "$n" -gt "$second_n" ]; then second=$s; second_n=$n; fi
done
echo "SELF-VIEW:  $best (signal=$best_n)"
echo "CROSS-VIEW: $second (signal=$second_n)"
```

Record both slugs in a comment and pass them forward (downstream reads them from this step's comment). The **cross-view** is a fetch of a DIFFERENT busy operator's page by a non-owner viewer (anonymous is fine — a non-owner sees full bodies by design). If only one busy operator exists, reuse the self-view slug for the cross-view but fetch it anonymously / under a distinct identity so it represents a non-owner — the whole point is to prove a non-owner sees full bodies.

### Verify the page + sub-sections (both views < 400)

```bash
for path in "/u/${best}" \
            "/u/${best}/inbox" \
            "/u/${best}/section/inbox" \
            "/u/${best}/section/forwarded" \
            "/u/${best}/section/recent-comments"; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' "${AUTH[@]}" "$BASE${path}")
  printf '%-48s -> %s\n' "$path" "$code"
done
```

### Deliverables (post as comments, then close)
- Comment: chosen self-view + cross-view slugs, how they were selected, and whether the run is AUTHENTICATED or ANONYMOUS (state which, so the report is honest).
- Comment: per-path HTTP status table.
- Comment: 'PASS' or per-path failure detail.

If the main page returns >= 400, do NOT close — file a bug parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK. A broken homepage is itself the highest-severity Fidelity finding. (A missing bearer is NOT a blocker — only an unreachable/broken page is.)

steps.title: Users-FLAT ({{ITERATION}}): capture screenshots + DOM for self-view AND cross-view of /u/{{USER_SLUG}}
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture (self-view + cross-view)

Run the Playwright harness against `{{TARGET_URL}}` for the chosen user homepage and store output under `docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/`. The harness injects `Authorization: Bearer $BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER` as an extraHTTPHeader **when set** and captures `/u/{slug}` as page `user-home` when `SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG` is set (ka-0000000737). When no bearer is available, the harness captures **anonymously** — valid for a flat-org page.

### Steps
1. Re-establish reachability from step 1 (direct ClusterIP DNS; best-effort bearer). Re-run the step-1 prereq block so `$BASE`, `${AUTH[@]}`, and `$VIEWER_BEARER` are set, then export:
   ```bash
   export BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER="$VIEWER_BEARER"   # may be empty → anonymous capture
   export SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG=<self-view-slug-from-step-1>
   export XVIEW_SLUG=<cross-view-slug-from-step-1>
   ```
2. Branch off fresh main:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git checkout main && git pull --ff-only
   git checkout -b chore/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}
   ```
3. Run the harness (captures all canonical pages incl. user-home; keep only user-home):
   ```bash
   BEADS_VIEWER_URL='{{TARGET_URL}}' make screenshot-beads-viewer
   ```
   Output: `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/test-results/beads-viewer-screenshots/{desktop,narrow}/user-home.{png,html}`.
4. Fetch raw rendered HTML for the self-view page + the **full inbox page** + each htmx sub-section, AND the **cross-view** (a non-owner fetch). Under the flat model a non-owner sees full bodies, so the cross-view may be an ANONYMOUS fetch of a DIFFERENT operator's page (or of the same page under a distinct/absent identity so `IsViewerSelf=false`).
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html
   for spec in "user-home:/u/${SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}" \
               "inbox-full:/u/${SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}/inbox" \
               "section-inbox:/u/${SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}/section/inbox" \
               "section-forwarded:/u/${SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}/section/forwarded" \
               "section-recent-comments:/u/${SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}/section/recent-comments"; do
     slug=${spec%%:*}; path=${spec#*:}
     curl -fsSL "${AUTH[@]}" "$BASE${path}" \
       -o "docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/${slug}.html" || echo "WARN: fetch $path failed"
   done
   # CROSS-VIEW: fetch the cross-view operator's page as a NON-OWNER. Prefer a
   # distinct busy operator (XVIEW_SLUG); anonymous (no AUTH) is a valid non-owner.
   # If a second bearer identity can be bootstrapped, use it; otherwise anon is fine.
   XSLUG="${XVIEW_SLUG:-$SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}"
   XAUTH=()   # anonymous non-owner by default (flat org → full bodies)
   if [ -n "$VIEWER_BEARER" ] && command -v mint_client_credentials_token >/dev/null 2>&1; then
     XBEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token 2>/dev/null) || XBEARER=""
     if [ -n "$XBEARER" ]; then
       XAUTH=(-H "Authorization: Bearer $XBEARER")
       curl -fsS -X POST "${XAUTH[@]}" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
         --data '{"kind":"agent","subject":"gardenio-users-flat-xview","source":"audit-xview"}' \
         http://localhost:8080/v1/operators/me/aliases >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
     fi
   fi
   for spec in "xview-user-home:/u/${XSLUG}" \
               "xview-inbox-full:/u/${XSLUG}/inbox" \
               "xview-section-inbox:/u/${XSLUG}/section/inbox"; do
     slug=${spec%%:*}; path=${spec#*:}
     curl -fsSL "${XAUTH[@]}" "$BASE${path}" \
       -o "docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/${slug}.html" || echo "WARN: xview fetch $path failed"
   done
   ```
5. Capture a cross-view SCREENSHOT too (Playwright run against the cross-view slug, anonymous or with the XBEARER), so the judge can SEE that bodies render for a non-owner:
   ```bash
   BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER="${XBEARER:-}" SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG="${XSLUG}" \
     BEADS_VIEWER_URL='{{TARGET_URL}}' make screenshot-beads-viewer || true
   mkdir -p docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/{desktop,narrow}
   cp gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/test-results/beads-viewer-screenshots/desktop/user-home.png \
      docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/xview-user-home.png 2>/dev/null || true
   ```
6. Re-run the harness for the SELF-VIEW owner (or reuse step-3 output) and move the self-view screenshots in:
   ```bash
   BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER="$VIEWER_BEARER" SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG="${SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}" \
     BEADS_VIEWER_URL='{{TARGET_URL}}' make screenshot-beads-viewer || true
   for vp in desktop narrow; do
     cp gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/test-results/beads-viewer-screenshots/$vp/user-home.png \
        docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/$vp/ 2>/dev/null || true
   done
   git add docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/
   git commit -m "chore(users-flat): capture {{ITERATION}} self+cross view for /u/${SCREENSHOT_USER_SLUG}"
   ```

### Deliverables
- Branch `chore/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}` with `captures/{html,screenshots}/` populated, including the `xview-*` HTML + screenshot.
- Comment: `du -sh` of captures + commit SHA + confirmation that self + cross-view captures exist, and whether captures were AUTHENTICATED or ANONYMOUS.

If the harness fails, root-cause it (check the viewer is reachable at `$BASE/health`; a MISSING bearer is expected on prod and is NOT a failure — only an unreachable/broken page is). BLOCK only on a genuinely broken/unreachable page, not on absent auth.

steps.title: Users-FLAT ({{ITERATION}}): compute objective metrics for the four dimensions
steps.description:
## Step 3: Measure (objective; no judgement)

Reuse `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-density.py` for the pixel/DOM vector, then layer a FLAT-specific pass with a new helper `measure-flat.py`. The four FLAT dimensions are **F**idelity, **L**egibility (transparency), **A**ll-in-time-series-order, **T**idiness.

### Fidelity signals (grep the captured HTML)
| Signal | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `error_markers` | count of `error`, `failed to`, `nil`, `panic`, `unprovisioned`, `no operator`, 5xx banners (case-insensitive) |
| `template_leaks` | count of literal `{{` / `}}` / `<no value>` rendered into the body |
| `broken_links` | count of `href="#"`, `href=""`, `href="/u/"` (slug-less), or `{{` in an href |
| `htmx_unresolved` | count of `hx-get` placeholders whose partial returned empty in the section fetches |

### Legibility / transparency signals (the headline of THIS gardener — compare self-view vs cross-view HTML)
| Signal | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `redaction_banner_present` | 1 if ANY of `message bodies are hidden`, `Viewing another operator`, `hidden`, `[redacted]` appears in `xview-*.html`. MUST be 0 — its presence is an automatic Legibility fail. |
| `xview_msg_count` | number of message bubbles (`user-inbox-msg`) in `xview-section-inbox.html` |
| `self_msg_count` | number of message bubbles in `section-inbox.html` |
| `xview_body_chars` | total visible character count inside `user-inbox-body` blocks in the cross-view |
| `self_body_chars` | same for the self-view |
| `transparency_ratio` | `xview_body_chars / max(1, self_body_chars)`. 1.0 == cross-view shows exactly as much as self-view (the goal). < 1 == bodies are being hidden cross-view. |

### Time-series-order signals (is it ONE chronological stream?)
| Signal | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `unified_timeline_present` | 1 if the page renders a single merged, timestamped activity stream (every row carrying a parseable timestamp in one ordered list), else 0 |
| `timeline_monotonic` | 1 if the timestamps in the primary stream are monotonically ordered (newest->oldest or oldest->newest, consistently), else 0 |
| `rows_with_timestamp` | count of activity rows carrying a visible/`title=` timestamp |
| `rows_total` | count of activity rows total |
| `timestamp_coverage` | `rows_with_timestamp / max(1, rows_total)` — fraction of activity that is time-anchored |
| `disjoint_section_cards` | count of separate dated section lists that are NOT merged into the main stream (each is a break in 'all in time-series order') |

### Tidiness / no-junk signals
| Signal | How to compute |
| --- | --- |
| `empty_section_markers` | count of empty-state strings (`No items`, `Nothing here`, `No messages`, `0 results`, empty `<tbody></tbody>`) occupying a full section band |
| `duplicate_rows` | count of activity rows whose (id|body) key repeats (the same event shown twice) |
| `near_white_ratio` | desktop, from measure-density.py — acres of blank is junk-by-omission |
| `data_fields` | desktop data-field count — signal actually present |

### Output
Write `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-flat.py` that ingests the captures dir and emits `docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json`:
```json
{
  "target_url": "{{TARGET_URL}}", "user_slug": "<self-slug>", "xview_slug": "<xview-slug>", "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}",
  "fidelity": {"error_markers": 0, "template_leaks": 0, "broken_links": 0, "htmx_unresolved": 0},
  "legibility": {"redaction_banner_present": 0, "xview_msg_count": 0, "self_msg_count": 0, "transparency_ratio": 1.0},
  "timeseries": {"unified_timeline_present": 0, "timeline_monotonic": 0, "timestamp_coverage": 0.0, "disjoint_section_cards": 0},
  "tidiness": {"empty_section_markers": 0, "duplicate_rows": 0, "near_white_ratio": 0.0, "data_fields": 0}
}
```
Commit the helper + metrics.json on the branch.

### Deliverables
- `measure-flat.py` + `metrics.json` committed.
- Comment: compact table of the headline numbers per dimension. Call out `redaction_banner_present` and `transparency_ratio` FIRST.
- If a screenshot is unreadable, mark its block `null` and warn — do not BLOCK (the judge skips nulls).

> **Flat-org note (revive-with-revisions):** the cross-view may be an ANONYMOUS non-owner fetch. Because beads-viewer applies no per-viewer content redaction, a healthy page yields `xview_body_chars == self_body_chars` → `transparency_ratio == 1.0` and `redaction_banner_present == 0`. That equality is the SOLVED transparency state, not a measurement artifact. If the cross-view was captured anonymously, say so in the metrics comment (the ratio still stands).

steps.title: Users-FLAT ({{ITERATION}}): score Fidelity / Legibility / time-series / Tidiness (the FLAT rubric)
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge — the FLAT rubric

Produce a 0-10 score + verdict for each of the **four** dimensions, combining the objective metrics (step 3) with a visual review of the screenshots. **You MUST visually inspect** `docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/user-home.png` (and narrow) AND `xview-user-home.png` with the Read tool — the screenshot is the source of truth; metrics only triage.

> **Why this gardener exists (operator's exact words):** *"gardenio is flat, users must be able to easily see others' activity as well as their own. The individual user's page is supposed to represent this. Total user activity transparency, but with no junk, and all in time-series order. Stuff we get today like 'Viewing another operator's feed — message bodies are hidden' — that's no good."* The page cannot score well overall while activity is hidden from a non-owner, scattered out of chronological order, or buried in junk — no matter how clean a single section looks.

### The four dimensions

**F — Fidelity** (is what's shown true and unbroken?)
- Any `template_leaks > 0`, `error_markers > 0`, or 5xx in a section => score <= 3 (broken).
- Broken/slug-less links, htmx sections that never resolve, stale or wrong counts => deduct.
- Visual: rendered page matches the DOM; no garbled rows, overlap, or misattributed names.
- 10 = every datum accurate, every link works, every section resolves.

**L — Legibility / Transparency** (HEADLINE — can a non-owner see EVERYTHING the owner can?)
- Hard gates from metrics:
  - `redaction_banner_present == 1` => **score <= 2.** Any 'bodies are hidden' / 'Viewing another operator' banner is the exact defect this gardener was created to kill.
  - `transparency_ratio < 0.98` => **score <= 4.** The cross-view must show essentially the same body content as the self-view (flat org). A meaningful gap means activity is being hidden from peers.
- Beyond the gates: are full message bodies, MR titles, decision text, and squawk content all visible to a non-owner? Is identity legible (who did what)? Are there any `[hidden]` / truncation-for-privacy affordances left anywhere?
- 10 = a peer opening someone else's page sees their complete activity record, bodies and all, with zero privacy redaction.

**A — All-in-time-series-order** (HEADLINE — is it ONE chronological stream, not scattered cards?)
- Anchor on `unified_timeline_present`, `timeline_monotonic`, `timestamp_coverage`, `disjoint_section_cards`.
- The operator wants activity 'all in time-series order'. A page that splits activity across many independently-sorted section cards (open MRs here, closed work there, messages elsewhere) is NOT in time-series order even if each card is internally sorted.
- Score bands:
  - No unified timeline AND many disjoint dated cards (`disjoint_section_cards >= 4`) => **score <= 3** (today's likely state).
  - Some sections share a sort key but there is no single merged stream => 4-5.
  - A primary merged activity stream exists but a few satellites sit outside it => 6-7.
  - One unified, timestamped, monotonic activity stream is the spine of the page (`timestamp_coverage >= 0.9`, `disjoint_section_cards <= 1`) => 8-9.
  - Plus crisp date grouping / 'today / this week / earlier' rails and a legible relative-time on every row => 10.
- Visual: can you run your eye down ONE column and watch this person's activity unfold in time? Reward that; penalize a dashboard of disconnected boxes.

**T — Tidiness** (no junk — Tufte signal-per-pixel + dedup + no empty noise)
- Anchor on `empty_section_markers`, `duplicate_rows`, `near_white_ratio` (desktop): >= 0.55 => <= 4; 0.40-0.55 => 5-6; 0.25-0.40 => 7-8; < 0.25 with a readable layout => 9-10.
- Penalize: empty-state section bands hogging prime real estate, the same event shown twice, acres of blank, raw unstyled lists, jarring color.
- Do NOT penalize functional gutters/margins.
- 10 = every pixel earns its place; nothing duplicated, nothing empty, nothing irrelevant.

### Output
`docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json`:
```json
{
  "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}", "user_slug": "<self>", "xview_slug": "<xview>",
  "scores": {
    "legibility": {"score": 0, "verdict": "broken|weak|ok|good|excellent", "observations": "...", "issues": ["..."], "recommendations": ["..."]},
    "timeseries": {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "tidiness":   {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "fidelity":   {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []}
  },
  "overall": {"score": 0.0, "headline": "one-line state-of-the-users-page"}
}
```
Score bands: 0-3 broken, 4-5 weak, 6-7 ok, 8-9 good, 10 excellent. `overall.score` = mean of the four. If Legibility < 5 OR time-series < 5, the headline MUST name that gap explicitly — those are the operator's stated pains.

### Deliverables
- `verdicts.json` committed on the branch.
- Comment: a 4-row scorecard (dimension | score | verdict | top recommendation) + the one-line headline, Legibility + time-series rows FIRST.
- Full `verdicts.json` pasted into a comment for the file-issues step.

> **Flat-org note (revive-with-revisions):** an anonymous non-owner cross-view is a VALID transparency proof. `transparency_ratio == 1.0` with `redaction_banner_present == 0` means a non-owner sees exactly what the owner sees — score Legibility HIGH (that is the operator's goal achieved), regardless of whether the capture was authenticated. Only an actual banner or a sub-1.0 ratio (content genuinely missing cross-view) should cap the score.

steps.title: Users-FLAT ({{ITERATION}}): file/refresh bug beads per low-scoring dimension
steps.description:
## Step 5: File Issues

For every of the **four** dimensions in `verdicts.json` scoring **<= 7** (anything short of 'good') file ONE bug bead with that dimension's concrete recommendations. The bar is high (<= 7, not <= 6) because this page is a primary transparency surface for a flat org — 'ok' still leaves a fix on the table.

### Per-dimension bug bead
```bash
kd create "Users page FLAT: <Dimension> scored <N>/10 — <one-line>" \
  --type=bug --project=gardenio -p 2 \
  -l project:gardenio -l area:beads-viewer -l kind:users-flat -l "flat:<dimension>"   # dimension in legibility|timeseries|tidiness|fidelity \
  --description "## FLAT audit context

Iteration: {{ITERATION}}
Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/u/<slug>  (cross-view: <xview-slug>)
Dimension: <Legibility|Time-series|Tidiness|Fidelity>
Score: <N>/10  (verdict: <verdict>)

## Observations
<verbatim from verdicts.json>

## Issues
- <bullet>

## Recommended fixes
- <bullet>

## Evidence
- Self desktop:  docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/user-home.png
- Cross desktop: docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/xview-user-home.png
- Metrics:       docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json

parent({{PARENT_EPIC}})"
```

### Priority: Legibility (transparency) and Time-series are the headlines
When filing the **legibility** or **timeseries** bug, set `-p 1` (not 2) and prefix the title `Users page: ` so it sorts to the top of the epic. These are the operator's explicit complaints; they should not get lost among polish bugs. If `redaction_banner_present == 1`, the legibility bug is `-p 0`.

### Deduplication (per dimension)
Before filing, search for an open bead with the same dimension scope:
```bash
kd list --status=open -l kind:users-flat -l "flat:<dimension>" 2>&1
```
If one exists, comment the new iteration's score + evidence on it (reference both iterations) instead of filing a duplicate. If the dimension has recovered to 8+ this iteration, comment that on the open bead and propose closing it.

### Deliverables
- Comment listing each filed-or-updated bug bead ID + its dimension + score.
- If all four dimensions score 8+, comment 'All four FLAT dimensions >= 8 this iteration — the users page is transparent, tidy, and chronological.' and close the step.
- Do NOT close {{PARENT_EPIC}} — the report step rolls up first.

steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR

Produce a rolled-up report on {{PARENT_EPIC}} and land captures+metrics+verdicts on main via an MR so future iterations can diff.

### Steps
1. Build `docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md`:
   - Header: iteration, target, self-view + cross-view slugs, date.
   - **FLAT scorecard**: 4-row table — dimension | score/10 | verdict | filed bug bead. (Legibility + Time-series rows first.)
   - Headline + overall score.
   - Inline-embed the self-view AND cross-view desktop screenshots side by side (the transparency proof).
   - Trends: if a previous `docs/users-flat/<previous>/verdicts.json` exists, diff each dimension's score + `transparency_ratio` + `timestamp_coverage`; flag deltas >= 1.0 (regression or recovery).
   - Index of bug beads filed/updated this iteration.
2. Commit + push + open MR:
   ```bash
   git add docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
   git commit -m "chore(users-flat): {{ITERATION}} roll-up report"
   git push -u origin chore/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}
   glab mr create \
     --title "chore(users-flat): {{ITERATION}} audit (overall <N>/10)" \
     --description "Automated Users-Page FLAT (transparency/time-series) audit for {{TARGET_URL}}/u/<slug>.\n\nReport: docs/users-flat/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md\nParent: {{PARENT_EPIC}}\nOperator: Matt Baker" \
     --remove-source-branch --squash-before-merge
   gb mr link <this-bead-id> <mr-url>
   ```
3. Wait for CI green; on transient flake, retrigger via the pipeline API (NEVER close/reopen — global advice).
4. Self-merge once green (gardenio repo, pre-authorized — advice ka-0000002230).
5. Comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}}:
   ```
   FLAT iteration {{ITERATION}} complete. User: /u/<slug>  (cross-view /u/<xview>)
   Scores — L:<n> A:<n> T:<n> F:<n>  (overall <n>/10)
   transparency_ratio=<r>  timestamp_coverage=<c>  redaction_banner=<0/1>
   Bug beads: <list>
   Report: <permalink at merge SHA>
   ```
6. Close this step bead. The gardener trigger fires the next iteration on cadence — incremental, continual progress toward a transparent, tidy, chronological users page.

### Terminal goal (for the gardener's stop condition)
The mission is DONE when, for two consecutive iterations, **all four FLAT dimensions score >= 8 on BOTH the self-view and the cross-view**, with `redaction_banner_present == 0` and `transparency_ratio >= 0.98`. At that point comment the recommendation to self-disable on {{PARENT_EPIC}} and let the operator confirm.
